steps.en: Run it on the machine where pi already runs
steps.zh: 在已经跑着 pi 的机器上启动它

steps.en: Starts a local server on loopback and opens the browser
steps.zh: 在回环地址起本地服务并打开浏览器

steps.en: Loads pi's sessions and settings from the pi agent directory
steps.zh: 从 pi 的 agent 数据目录读出会话与配置

steps.en: Sign in to a provider or add an API key (first run)
steps.zh: 登录模型供应商或填入 API key（仅首次）

steps.en: Browse sessions grouped by project, resume one, send a message
steps.zh: 按项目浏览会话，恢复一条或直接发消息

steps.en: Runs the turn with pi's own engine and writes back to the same session files
steps.zh: 用 pi 自己的引擎跑这一轮，写回同一份会话文件

value.en: Your pi agent gets a browser workspace — sessions, models, files — on the exact on-disk state the terminal uses, with zero migration
value.zh: pi 有了浏览器工作台：会话、模型、文件都落在终端正在用的同一份状态上，零迁移

sources: README Quick Start (npx @agegr/pi-web@latest; http://127.0.0.1:30141; Models panel to sign in or add an API key)
README Notes — Agent data (~/.pi/agent, sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<timestamp>_<uuid>.jsonl; shared model/settings/credential storage)
